In this video, Shashank ranks the Top 10 Health Insurance Companies in India and explains what each insurer actually does well, where they fall short, and which plans are worth looking at.

What this video covers:
→ Claim Settlement Ratio comparison
→ Complaint volumes across insurers
→ Hospital network strength
→ Product quality vs servicing quality
→ Which insurers are best for metros vs Tier-2 cities
→ Wellness-focused insurers vs stable traditional insurers
→ Which companies are innovating the fastest
→ Which insurers feel most reliable during claims

→ HDFC ERGO

Here’s the important thing.

A health insurance company is not just its marketing.

What really matters is:
→ How they behave during claims
→ Whether the product actually covers what you need
→ How consistently they service customers
→ Whether their pricing remains sustainable long term

That’s why blindly buying the “most popular” insurer can backfire.

This ranking is based on Ditto’s broader framework (https://joinditto.in/articles/general/dittos-cut/) using measurable factors like claim settlement ratio, complaint ratios, financial scale, network hospitals, and operational maturity — not just one flashy metric.
